result.instructions: Tools for Attentive, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is +13115552368 still opted in to text messages?"; "List our segments that changed in the last 7 days."; "Create a segment called Loyalty Gold Members and describe it as gold loyalty customers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Attentive data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run attentive_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run attentive_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run attentive_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. attentive_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: attentive_me
tools.title: Check API key
tools.description: Return the company and app behind the current API key. Use it first to confirm the connection works. Attentive API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: attentive_get_subscriptions
tools.title: Get subscription eligibility
tools.description: List the subscription types and channels (TEXT or EMAIL) a subscriber is opted in to, so you can check if they can receive a campaign. Look up by phone or email. Attentive API: GET /v1/subscriptions.

phone.description: Subscriber phone in E.164 format, for example +13115552368. Give phone or email, not both.

email.description: Subscriber email. Give phone or email, not both.

tools.name: attentive_get_custom_attributes
tools.title: Get custom attributes
tools.description: Return all custom attribute values stored for one subscriber. Look up by phone or email, not both. Attentive API: GET /v1/attributes/custom.

phone.description: Subscriber phone in E.164 format, for example +13115552368. Give phone or email, not both.

email.description: Subscriber email. Give phone or email, not both.

tools.name: attentive_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List segments with optional filters: name (partial match), externalId, updatedSince (ISO 8601). Use cursor from the previous response for the next page. Attentive API: GET /v2/segments.

name.description: Partial match on the segment name.

externalId.description: Exact external id of the segment.

updatedSince.description: Only segments updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tools.name: attentive_get_segment
tools.title: Get a segment
tools.description: Get one segment by its external id, including its name, description and status. Attentive API: GET /v2/segments/external/{externalId}.

tools.name: attentive_get_clear_segment_status
tools.title: Get clear-segment status
tools.description: Return the status of the latest clear-segment request for a segment (processing state, timestamps, failure reason). Attentive API: GET /v2/segments/external/{externalId}/clear-segment/status.

tools.name: attentive_get_bulk_job_status
tools.title: Get bulk job status
tools.description: Check a bulk ingestion job by its id. The state is IN_PROGRESS, NEEDS_REVIEW, COMPLETED or CANCELLED, with totals. Attentive API: GET /v2/bulk/job/{bulkJobId}.

bulk_job_id.description: The bulkJobId returned by the bulk upload.

tools.name: attentive_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured for this app: their target URLs and the event types they receive (for example sms.subscribed, sms.sent). Attentive API: GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: attentive_unsubscribe
tools.title: Unsubscribe a subscriber
tools.description: Unsubscribe one subscriber from the given subscription types and channels. If subscriptions is empty, the subscriber is unsubscribed from all. This changes consent: the subscriber stops receiving those messages. Attentive API: POST /v1/subscriptions/unsubscribe.

phone.description: Subscriber phone in E.164 format, for example +13115552368. Give phone or email, not both.

email.description: Subscriber email. Give phone or email, not both.

subscriptions.description: Type and channel pairs to unsubscribe. Leave empty to unsubscribe from all.

disable_confirmation_message.description: True to skip the confirmation message.

tools.name: attentive_create_segment
tools.title: Create a segment
tools.description: Create a new, empty segment. Members are added later. A segment can drive campaigns and journeys, so check the name first. Attentive API: POST /v2/segments.

external_id.description: Optional external id. Attentive generates one when omitted.

tools.name: attentive_update_segment
tools.title: Update a segment
tools.description: Change the name or description of a segment, found by external id. Give at least one of name or description. Attentive API: PATCH /v2/segments/external/{externalId}.

tools.name: attentive_archive_segment
tools.title: Archive a segment
tools.description: Archive (soft delete) a segment by external id. It leaves list results and can be restored in the Attentive platform. Campaigns or journeys that use it may change. Attentive API: DELETE /v2/segments/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: The segment external id to archive.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Attentive
prompts.description: What you can do with Attentive here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_whether_a_subscriber_can_receive_a_campaign
prompts.title: Check whether a subscriber can receive a campaign
prompts.description: Look up a subscriber by phone number or email. See the text and email channels they are opted in to, and their custom attribute values.

prompts.name: review_segments_and_their_clear_status
prompts.title: Review segments and their clear status
prompts.description: List segments changed since a date. Then open one segment and check the status of its latest clear-segment request.

prompts.name: track_a_bulk_subscriber_import
prompts.title: Track a bulk subscriber import
prompts.description: Check the state and totals of a bulk ingestion job. List the webhooks and the event types they receive, such as sms.subscribed.

prompts.name: create_or_rename_a_segment
prompts.title: Create or rename a segment
prompts.description: Create an empty segment, or change the name or description of one. Segments can drive campaigns and journeys, so check the name first.

prompts.name: unsubscribe_a_subscriber_from_text_marketing
prompts.title: Unsubscribe a subscriber from text marketing
prompts.description: Unsubscribe one subscriber from text or email subscriptions. This changes consent, so the subscriber stops receiving those messages.

prompts.name: archive_a_segment_that_is_no_longer_used
prompts.title: Archive a segment that is no longer used
prompts.description: Read the segment, then archive it. An archived segment leaves list results and can be restored in Attentive. Campaigns or journeys that use it may change.
